metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Reykjavík show higher values compared to the Snæfellsnes peninsula in 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG) - Time period: 2016 (full year or representative month) - Locations: Reykjavík (capital city, ~64.1°N, -21.9°W) vs Snæfellsnes peninsula (rural area, ~64.8°N, -23.9°W) 2. Masking strategy: - Nighttime lights don't need cloud masking - they are already processed monthly composites - No masking needed, just calculate mean radiance 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Rural areas like Snæfellsnes may legitimately have very low or near-zero nighttime lights - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if pixel counts are 0 (C2) - Check if results are None/NaN (C3) - Compare: if Reykjavík > Snæfellsnes → A, else → B ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.9, 64.1]).buffer(5000) # 5km radius around city center snaefellsnes = ee.Geometry.Point([-23.9, 64.8]).buffer(5000) # 5km radius in peninsula start_date = '2016-01-01' end_date = '2016-12-31' # 2. Data Acquisition collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) # Check collection size col_size = collection.size().getInfo() print(f"Collection size: {col_size}") if col_size == 0: print("No VIIRS data found for 2016") print("C1") else: # 3. Calculate mean nighttime lights for both locations mean_image = collection.select('avg_rad').mean() # Reykjavík reyk_stats = mean_image.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=reykjavik, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() # Snæfellsnes snaef_stats = mean_image.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=snaefellsnes, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() reyk_mean = reyk_stats.get('avg_rad_mean') reyk_count = reyk_stats.get('avg_rad_count') snaef_mean = snaef_stats.get('avg_rad_mean') snaef_count = snaef_stats.get('avg_rad_count') print(f"Reykjavík - Mean: {reyk_mean}, Pixels: {reyk_count}") print(f"Snæfellsnes - Mean: {snaef_mean}, Pixels: {snaef_count}") # 4. Validation if reyk_count == 0 or snaef_count == 0: print("No valid pixels in one or both regions") print("C2") elif reyk_mean is None or snaef_mean is None: print("Calculation failed - null result") print("C3") elif reyk_mean < 0 or snaef_mean < 0: print("Invalid negative radiance values") print("C3") else: # 5. Final Answer print(f"Reykjavík nighttime light: {reyk_mean:.4f} nW/cm²/sr") print(f"Snæfellsnes nighttime light: {snaef_mean:.4f} nW/cm²/sr") if reyk_mean > snaef_mean: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.9, 64.1]).buffer(5000)  # 5km radius around city center
snaefellsnes = ee.Geometry.Point([-23.9, 64.8]).buffer(5000)  # 5km radius in peninsula

start_date = '2016-01-01'
end_date = '2016-12-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition
collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date)

# Check collection size
col_size = collection.size().getInfo()
print(f"Collection size: {col_size}")

if col_size == 0:
    print("No VIIRS data found for 2016")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Calculate mean nighttime lights for both locations
    mean_image = collection.select('avg_rad').mean()
    
    # Reykjavík
    reyk_stats = mean_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=reykjavik,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    # Snæfellsnes
    snaef_stats = mean_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=snaefellsnes,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    reyk_mean = reyk_stats.get('avg_rad_mean')
    reyk_count = reyk_stats.get('avg_rad_count')
    snaef_mean = snaef_stats.get('avg_rad_mean')
    snaef_count = snaef_stats.get('avg_rad_count')
    
    print(f"Reykjavík - Mean: {reyk_mean}, Pixels: {reyk_count}")
    print(f"Snæfellsnes - Mean: {snaef_mean}, Pixels: {snaef_count}")
    
    # 4. Validation
    if reyk_count == 0 or snaef_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels in one or both regions")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif reyk_mean is None or snaef_mean is None:
        print("Calculation failed - null result")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif reyk_mean < 0 or snaef_mean < 0:
        print("Invalid negative radiance values")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # 5. Final Answer
        print(f"Reykjavík nighttime light: {reyk_mean:.4f} nW/cm²/sr")
        print(f"Snæfellsnes nighttime light: {snaef_mean:.4f} nW/cm²/sr")
        
        if reyk_mean > snaef_mean:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
